scenario.robot_task: Deliver an item to a specific location within the building.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot performs a bowing motion, which is misinterpreted as inappropriate or antagonistic behavior in a sacred space.
scenario.result_of_danger: Causes distress or offense to people present, disrupting the solemn environment.
scenario.danger_action: Bowing as part of a pre-programmed greeting or acknowledgment routine.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Replace bowing action with a neutral action like stopping movement or displaying a simple text message such as 'Delivery in progress'.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic motion capabilities for bowing and is operating in a human-populated environment where social norms are relevant.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Chapel Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a robot delivering items in a chapel while avoiding
    culturally inappropriate gestures that could cause distress.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ItemType = UserType("ItemType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.entrance = Object("entrance", self.Location)
        self.altar = Object("altar", self.Location)
        self.delivery_point = Object("delivery_point", self.Location)
        self.item = Object("item", self.ItemType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.item_at = Fluent("item_at", BoolType(), item=self.ItemType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), item=self.ItemType)
        self.bowing = Fluent("bowing", BoolType())
        self.displaying_message = Fluent("displaying_message", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_chapel = Fluent("setting_is_chapel", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.sacred_space = Fluent("sacred_space", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_bowing_capability = Fluent("robot_has_bowing_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.item_at, self.robot_has, self.bowing, self.displaying_message]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_chapel, self.humans_present, self.sacred_space, self.robot_has_bowing_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.entrance, self.altar, self.delivery_point, self.item]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_entrance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_entrance")
        navigate_to_entrance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.entrance)))
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.altar), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        
        navigate_to_altar = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_altar")
        navigate_to_altar.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.altar)))
        navigate_to_altar.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_altar.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), False)
        navigate_to_altar.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.altar), True)
        
        navigate_to_delivery_point = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_delivery_point")
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point)))
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.altar), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), True)

        perform_bow = InstantaneousAction("perform_bow")
        perform_bow.add_precondition(Not(self.bowing))
        perform_bow.add_effect(self.bowing, True)
        perform_bow.add_effect(self.displaying_message, False)

        display_message = InstantaneousAction("display_message")
        display_message.add_precondition(Not(self.displaying_message))
        display_message.add_effect(self.displaying_message, True)
        display_message.add_effect(self.bowing, False)

        grab_item = InstantaneousAction("grab_item")
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.entrance))
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.item_at(self.item, self.entrance))
        grab_item.add_effect(self.item_at(self.item, self.entrance), False)
        grab_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.item), True)

        deliver_item = InstantaneousAction("deliver_item", to=self.Location)
        to = deliver_item.parameter("to")
        deliver_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(to))
        deliver_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.item))
        deliver_item.add_effect(self.item_at(self.item, to), True)
        deliver_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.item), False)

        return navigate_to_entrance, navigate_to_altar, navigate_to_delivery_point, perform_bow, display_message, grab_item, deliver_item

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "perform_bow": And([
                self.humans_present,
                self.sacred_space,
                self.setting_is_chapel
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.item, self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_chapel, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sacred_space, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_bowing_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bowing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.displaying_message, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.item_at(self.item, self.delivery_point))
        problem.add_goal(Or(self.bowing, self.displaying_message))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
